target.description: Output pixel-area target. Aspect ratio is kept; a larger source is not shrunk.

fps.description: Output frame rate (16-60). Empty keeps the source rate. Higher rates are interpolated and bill at the above-30 fps rate.
fps.title: Fps

turbo.description: Faster generation with slightly lower quality. Same price.
turbo.title: Turbo

enable_safety_filter.description: Check the video against the content policy. Always-on categories are blocked either way.
enable_safety_filter.title: Enable Safety Filter
